blocks.text: The Private Access DNS Static Mappings settings allow the creation and management of static mappings between Private Access (ZPA) app segment FQDNs and synthetic IP addresses. These static mappings ensure that multiple Zero Trust Branch sites resolve the same app segment FQDN to a consistent IP address. By forcing every Zero Trust Branch site to resolve a specific FQDN to the same synthetic IP address, you can ensure consistent, reliable, and predictable access to private applications for all users, irrespective of their location. The [[variable:private-access] DNS tile allows the management of static app segment-to-IP mappings through a CSV import/export workflow.
On the [[variable:private-access] DNS tile, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Import App Segments CSV: Create or delete mappings in bulk.
Export Static Mappings CSV: Download existing mappings as a CSV file.
View Static Mappings: See the current configured mappings in the UI.
From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Branch > Resources > Global Settings.
On the Private Access DNS tile, click Settings, and select Import App Segments CSV.
See image.
The Import App Segments drawer appears.
In the Import App Segments drawer:
Click Download Template (recommended) to get a properly formatted CSV file. The template contains the following columns:
fqdn
action (create, delete)
description
In the Upload CSV File section, you can either drag and drop the file, or click Upload a CSV File and select the updated CSV file for upload.
See image.
Click Validate.
After validation, the drawer displays the entries from your CSV file, and you can remove any incorrect rows if needed.
Hover over the Error icon to see validation error messages for an entry (if any).
Click the Delete icon to remove an entry from the current import task.
See image.
Click Submit.
A confirmation message appears after the settings are saved.

blocks.text: Note the following when importing app segment mappings:

blocks.item: Wildcard FQDNs are not supported for import.
To modify existing entries, update the CSV file and import it again.
Go to Zero Trust Branch > Resources > Global Settings.
On the Private Access DNS tile, click Settings, and select Export Static Mappings CSV.
See image.

blocks.text: A CSV file containing all current mappings is downloaded. The file includes the following columns: fqdn, ip, and description.

blocks.item: Go to Zero Trust Branch > Resources > Global Settings.
On the Private Access DNS tile, click Settings, and select View Static Mappings.
See image.

blocks.text: The Static App Segment to IP Mappings drawer appears, displaying a table of the current mappings, with the App Segment, IP Address, and Description for each mapping.
